name: Gatehouse Managed Security
blurb: Runs firewalls for small firms that cannot run their own. One console, many clients.
banner: Client perimeters managed from this system: 14

content.text:
ALL CLIENT PERIMETERS: OPERATIONAL

Scheduled maintenance this Sunday. Clients may see short interruptions.

RUNBOOK · CLIENT PERIMETERS

Each client's firewall is driven from this console. When an engineer opens a client's session here for a change, that client's firewall is put in maintenance mode and passes everything until the session closes.

Do not leave sessions open. We had a complaint from Brennan & Marsh in January.

Clients on this console include: Brennan & Marsh LLP (BO-DOCS), Harrow Dental, three others.
